text: Which neutrophil-specific plasma membrane proteins (blood immune cells) are not enriched in the T-cell lineage and have an atlas antibody?
plan: Immune cell category (RNA): Neutrophil / Immune cell enriched AND Subcellular location (ICC): Plasma membrane AND NOT Immune cell lineage category (RNA): T-cells / Lineage enriched, Group enriched AND With antibodies: Yes
understanding: The question asks for genes that are specific to neutrophils among blood immune cells, localize to the plasma membrane, are not enriched in the T-cell lineage, and have an available atlas antibody.

trail.why: The requirement asks for genes specific to neutrophils among blood immune cells, which corresponds to selecting 'neutrophil' at Level 1 and 'Immune cell enriched' at Level 2, defining at least a four-fold higher mRNA level in neutrophils compared to any other immune cell type.
The requirement specifies plasma membrane proteins, which matches the level 1 location 'Plasma membrane' with no restrictions specified on level 2 reliability or annotation types.

trail.requirement: not enriched in the T-cell lineage
trail.why: Selects enrichment categories (Lineage enriched and Group enriched) specifically for T-cells to identify genes enriched in the T-cell lineage for exclusion.
The requirement specifies that the proteins must have an atlas antibody, which corresponds to selecting 'Yes' for the 'With antibodies' filter.
